content: Papuru Maritatsie kemɨtiuyeikakai
Merikɨtsɨ te'utawikweka, 'anake tekatenetimani kwie hapa mɨyemakai Marita katinitewakaitɨni.
Teɨteri mana kiekatari yemekɨ 'aixɨa mekateniu'iyarikaitɨni tahepaɨtsita. Me'atinaika, mekatani'iniekaitɨni 'ahurawa temukɨnekɨ, mɨwiyekaikɨ meta muhaɨtɨkaikɨ.
Hikɨ Papuru nekukɨ'eni, taipa menutixɨrienikɨ. Kuu tai makatɨ yuta'unake, mamayatsie kanitakeni.

Teɨteri mana kiekatari me'ixeiyatɨ kuu mamayatsie hawiekame, mɨpaɨ mekateniyukɨhɨawekaitɨni yunaitɨ: «Xɨari 'ikɨ tewi tiyumiekame pɨhɨkɨ, tsepanetɨ haramaratsie mutawikwei, heitserie pɨkapitɨarie 'ayenieretɨ mɨyuhayewanikɨ».
Matsi Papuru yumama kaniutatsike, kuu taipa kaneuweni, mɨkɨ 'atsipɨka'uyɨ pɨkatiukwinixɨ.

Mɨkɨ teɨteri mepikwewiekai mɨpaɨ meteku'eriwatɨ: «Tietɨtsɨ tahaimɨkɨ, yatɨni yapauka mɨmɨkɨ». Yamekateneutere me'itaxeiyatɨ 'atsipɨka'uyɨ, 'ayumieme yɨkɨ pɨta mekateniuyɨhɨawe, mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: «Xɨari 'ikɨ kanikakaɨyaritɨni».

Hikɨ mana hurawa kwie kanikumakaitɨni, Pupiriyu naitɨ kwie haramara hixɨapa mɨyema katinipinieyatɨkaitɨni. Mɨkɨ yukie 'aixɨa tatixeiyatɨ kataniutanaki'erieni hikɨ haika tukari mana tekanikutekaitɨni hetsɨana.
Pupiriyu paapaya hɨiyakɨ meta hakwitsikɨ tikuyetɨ yu'itaritsie kanikakateitɨni. Papuru kaneikuxeiya, meta kaniyutanenewieni heimana 'utimetɨ 'ana mɨkɨ 'aixɨa reu'erietɨ kanayani.
Mɨyatiuyɨku, hipatɨta tekwikwikate haramara hixɨapa kwie mɨyematsie memɨtamakai mekani'axekaitɨni, mɨkɨta 'aixɨa meteheu'erietɨ mepakɨkakai.
Mɨkɨ waɨkawa 'aixɨa metatexeiyatɨ metatenimikwakaitɨni, meta teyehuximekaku mepɨtateyetuiri ketita temɨteheuyehɨakai.
Papuru Xumatsie kemɨreta'a
Hikɨ haika metseri te'uyurieka haramara hixɨapa kwie mɨyematsie, kanuwa 'amɨpatsie teyetekaku kaniukuhaɨtɨre. 'Arekanitɨriya miemetsie, kakaɨyarixi memuyuhuta wa'ɨkiyari mamakai.
Tsirakutsa teheta'axɨaka, haika tukari mana tekaniuyurieni.
Manata temɨyekɨ, Rekiyu tekaniye'axɨani. Xeitukari 'anukayaku, tatsɨtɨa 'eka kanatineni, meta hutarieka tukaritsie Putehuri tekaneta'axɨani.
Mana ta'iwamarixi tekaniwaretaxeiya, mɨkɨ mepɨtatsi'uta'ini 'atahuta tukari temɨyurienikɨ wahetsɨa. 'Imatɨrieka Xumatsie tekaniuta'axɨani.

Ta'iwamarixi Xuma kiekatari, mete'utamarieka tahepaɨtsita ketemeyɨkai, mɨrayutixexeɨritɨre paitɨ 'Apiyu huyeyari 'utɨma meta Haikatɨ mɨti'u mɨtiuyehipitɨretsie me'ayenexɨaka mekatananunake. Papuru waruxeiyaka, Kakaɨyari pamɨpariyutsi kaniupitɨani, meta waɨkawa kaniyuwaɨriyakaitɨni.
Kepauka Xumatsie temu'axɨa, Papuru kaniupitɨarieni yuxaɨtame kiita mayekanikɨ, xeime kuya hamatɨa mi'ɨwiyanikɨ.
Papuru Xumatsie kemɨtikuxatakai

Merikɨtsɨ hairieka tukaritsie Papuru huriyutsixi wa'ukiyarima yuhetsɨa kaniwaruta'inieni. Me'u'axɨaku mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Neuxei 'iwamarixi, tsepanetɨ 'atsinemɨkatiuyuri teɨteri wahepaɨtsita, tatutsima wayeiyari hepaɨtsita neka'uxiwa'atɨ, Kerutsaremetsie nehɨatɨ nepɨyetuiya xumatari wahetsɨa.
Mɨkɨ menetsi'uta'iwawiyaka mekanenixɨnakukaitɨni, ne 'axanemɨkatiuyuriekaikɨ nemɨmierienikɨ.
Huriyutsixi neniuki hepaɨtsita memɨniukixiekai, 'ayumieme waɨriyarika Tsetsaxi hetsɨa nekaniye'ani, tsepanetɨ neteɨterima wahepaɨtsita tixaɨtɨ nemɨkarayexeiyakai.
Hikɨ 'ayumieme nekanixe'uta'inieni temɨtaxeiyaxɨanikɨ meta xehamatɨa nemɨtitaxatakɨ. Mɨpaɨ yuri nemɨti'eriekɨ 'Ixaheri teɨteriyari kememɨteta'ikwewa 'ayumieme tepɨakɨ hikɨ nekanihɨaka.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenita'eiya: —Tame xapate tepɨka'anuhuriwawe Kureyatsie mieme 'ahepaɨtsita tikuxatame, meta xewitɨ ta'iwa pɨkanuawe 'axatatihekɨatɨatɨ yanɨtsɨtɨni 'axatikuxatatɨ 'ahepaɨtsita.
Matsi tekani'eniekuni kepemɨtiku'eriwa, mɨkɨtsie memɨtewiya wahepaɨtsita 'ikɨ xeikɨa tepɨtemate, naitsarie 'axamekatenikuxaxatsiwani.

Hikɨ xeitukari mekananayexeiya Papuru hetsɨa memɨyukuxeɨrienikɨ, 'ana yumɨiretɨ mekaniu'axɨani kiitana mɨwayekatsie. Ximeripaitɨ 'itsutɨaka taikaike katiniutahayewa, tiwakuxaxatɨwatɨ meta tiwahekɨatɨatɨ kemɨreuyewetse Kakaɨyari ti'aitametɨkaku hepaɨtsita, yuri tiwa'eritɨamɨtɨ Ketsutsi hetsie, Muitsexi 'inɨarieyakɨ, meta Kakaɨyari niukametemama waxapayaritsie mɨkɨkɨ yuniuki tseiriyatɨ.
Hipatɨ yuri mekatenita'eririeni kemɨtikuxatakai, hipatɨta yuri mepɨkate'uta'eri.

Yunaitɨ yaxeikɨa meteyɨkɨhɨawetɨ mepɨkaheutayeixɨa, mekanitakɨkakaitɨni kepauka 'imatɨrieka Papuru mɨpaɨ mutayɨ: «Yurikɨ 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata 'aixɨa kaniutayɨni, Kitsariyaxi Kakaɨyari niukameya mɨpaɨ tatutsima tiwarutahɨaweku:

content.text: tsepanetɨ waɨkawa xemeuneniere, matsi tixaɨtɨ xepɨkatexeiya’.
meta nehetsɨa mepɨ'axɨanikeyu, ne 'aixɨa meteheu'eriekame nepɨwarayeitɨawe”.

content: »'Ayumieme xeme yaxeketenemaika, Kakaɨyari 'ikɨ wikweitsitɨarika kaneyenɨ'ani memɨkahuriyutsixi wahetsɨa, mɨkɨ hɨrixɨa mekani'eniekuni».
Hikɨ mɨpaɨ 'utayɨku huriyutsixi mekanekɨne niuki waɨkawa mexɨatɨatɨ.
Hikɨ huta wiyari kaniuyurieni muwa 'ayekaitɨ yɨkɨmana tiyutuatɨ. Yunaitɨ hetsɨana memɨ'axekai 'aixɨa katiniwaxeiyakaitɨni.
Kamatɨ katinikuxatakaitɨni kemɨreuyewetse Kakaɨyari ti'aitametɨkaku, meta katini'ɨkitakaitɨni Ti'aitame Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu hepaɨtsita, xewitɨ ka'iku'imaiyakaku meta xeime kaheumakatɨ.
